title: GM console config.json
description: Per-environment configuration of the GM console, served next to index.html (slice 018, FR-050). The console checks the same rules at start (packages/shell/src/config/loadConfig.ts); unknown members are ignored.

apiBaseUrl.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the GM API, without query, fragment or user info; a trailing / is ignored. Its origin must be in the static host's CSP connect-src.

gameId.description: Game id of the GM API (/me gameId); the console blocks on another value (Q19).

environmentId.description: Environment id of the GM API (/me environmentId); the console blocks on another value (Q19).
